document_flags: FLAG-A: Glossary (p.15) lists course code "PHY 105" for Introduction to Social and Political Philosophy. Course tables and course content throughout the document consistently use "PHL 105". The PHL 105 rendering is used throughout this extraction as it is the majority usage. [FLAG FOR MANUAL REVIEW]

FLAG-B: ICL 101 (LL.B Common and Islamic Law, 100-level): Table (p.57) shows 2 units / LH 30. Course content section (p.63) shows 3 Units C: LH 45. Discrepancy in both units and contact hours. Both versions are recorded verbatim at P12 and P13 respectively. [FLAG FOR MANUAL REVIEW]

FLAG-C: ICL 304 (LL.B Common and Islamic Law, 300-level): Table (p.57–58) lists this course as "Enterprise Appreciation" / 2 units / LH 30 / C. Course content section (p.73–74) presents "ICL 304: Islamic Family Law" with 3 units / LH 45. Title, unit load, and contact hours all conflict. This is a major discrepancy in the source document. Both versions are recorded verbatim. [FLAG FOR MANUAL REVIEW — CRITICAL]

FLAG-D: LL.B Common and Islamic Law 500-level table (p.59): JIL 501, JIL 502, PPL 501, PPL 502 are listed with LH 60 and no PH column. Course content sections for all four courses show LH 45 / PH 45. The table also omits a PH column header for this level entirely. [FLAG FOR MANUAL REVIEW]

FLAG-E: LAW 599 in LL.B Common and Islamic Law 500-level table (p.59) shows LH 270 with no PH. The same course in the LL.B table shows LH 45 / PH 45. Course content text for both programmes is identical and does not specify LH/PH breakdown. [FLAG FOR MANUAL REVIEW]
FLAG-F: ENT 211 in LL.B Common and Islamic Law 200-level table (p.57): PH column appears blank. The same course in the LL.B table shows PH 15. [FLAG FOR MANUAL REVIEW]

FLAG-G: ICL 301 in course content section (p.73) is presented without the "ICL" prefix in the section heading, reading only "301: Mu'amalat (Islamic Law of Transactions)". The course code ICL 301 is used in this extraction as it appears in the 300-level table. [FLAG FOR MANUAL REVIEW]
